hero.headline: Your Daily Companion for Quran & Worship
hero.description: Experience a comprehensive Islamic companion that seamlessly brings together Holy Quran reading in authentic Uthmani script, beautiful recitations, exact astronomical prayer times, Qibla compass direction, and daily prophetic Azkar — all within an elegant, serene interface.

features.title: Thoughtfully Crafted Features for Your Worship
features.subtitle: Combining essential spiritual practices and Quranic knowledge into a modern, fluid mobile interface tailored for the entire family.
features.f1Desc: The entire Holy Quran across all 114 Surahs in authentic Uthmani script, fully accessible for offline reading without an internet connection.
features.f2Desc: Listen to world-renowned reciters with automatic real-time verse highlighting, customizable playback speed, and repeat controls.
features.f3Desc: Calculate exact daily prayer times tailored to your geographic GPS coordinates or by choosing your city from preset Islamic capitals.
features.f4Desc: Easily pinpoint the exact direction of the Holy Kaaba in Mecca utilizing your device's built-in magnetometer and compass sensors.
features.f5Desc: Maintain your morning and evening supplications, post-prayer dhikr, and sleep azkar with bookmarking and instant search options.
features.f6Desc: Stay connected to your prayers with melodious Adhan calls and custom daily reminders that you explicitly configure.

reading.title: Read, Listen, and Reflect Simultaneously
reading.subtitle: Follow along verse by verse as the recitation plays, creating a deeply immersive and contemplative spiritual experience.
reading.point1Desc: The reading page smoothly tracks and highlights the active Ayah in elegant gold in direct harmony with the recitation audio.
reading.point2Desc: Stream recitations from Sheikh Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais, Mishary Rashid Alafasy, Maher Al-Muaiqly, Saad Al-Ghamdi, and Abdul Basit Abdul Samad.
reading.point3Desc: Repeat individual verses for memorization (Hifz), repeat entire chapters, adjust playback speeds, and customize Arabic font sizes.

offline.title: The Holy Quran With You Wherever You Go
offline.subtitle: Engineered for seamless offline reading, ensuring unhindered spiritual engagement even during travel or without network coverage.
offline.item1Desc: All 114 Surahs and 6,236 verses reside directly on your device, enabling complete offline reading of the sacred text.
offline.item2Desc: The application automatically remembers your exact last read Surah and Ayah, allowing you to instantly resume your Khatmah.
offline.item3Desc: All supplications, prayers, and dhikr categories are bundled locally for complete offline access anytime, anywhere.

languages.title: Available in 6 Global Languages
languages.subtitle: Al Quran Academy provides comprehensive native localization to serve Muslims worldwide.
languages.note: Switch your preferred application language instantly from the in-app Settings screen.

download.title: Start Your Quran Journey Today
download.description: Download the Al Quran Academy mobile application now on your Android smartphone and elevate your daily worship experience.

footer.description: Al Quran Academy – A premier free Islamic application dedicated to facilitating the recitation, listening, and understanding of the Holy Quran, accurate prayer times, and authentic Azkar.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Al Quran Academy ('we', 'our', or 'us') is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency in all our data practices. This Privacy Policy details the technical behavior, permissions, and safeguards governing our mobile application and official website.
